dedupe_keys.name: rge alti masque de qualite de source seine maritime

description: RGE® ALTI Masque de qualité de source - Seine-Maritime is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The MNT RGE ALTI® is a digital model of mesh terrain distributed in the footsteps of 1 m and 5 m. It describes the normal shape and altitude of the soil surface. It is designed for use on scales between 1: 3,000 and 1: 20 000. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "RGE® ALTI Source Quality Mask — Seine-Maritime" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include altitude, précision altimétrique, Modèle Numérique de Terrain. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
